messages:
mira: quick sync — thinking about per-route insights ownership + sampling cascade. my rough idea: snapshots that are immutable, can be delegated to teams, and sampling rate inherits route -> model -> global with an explicit override chain. want quick gut-check before i write an API proposal.
aj: @mira :eyes: can you sketch how ttl/versioning works? if a delegated owner tweaks filters does the snapshot fork or mutate?
mira: fork. snapshot is immutable. editing creates a new derived snapshot with a parent pointer and author metadata. rough API: POST /snapshots { route, base_snapshot_id, filters, owner } -> returns id. no inline mutation.
ben: :+1: immutability avoids drift. ui thought: show owner badge + small “fork” affordance; for non-owners show “request edit” option.
leo: i lean toward making non-owners use “request edit” to reduce accidental forks. also we need to surface sampling cost impact — if sampling goes up it can impact route quotas. add a confirmation step in the UI.
sara: routing/quotas note: sampled requests count against the route's quota. if owner increases sampling we should show a projected monthly token estimate and block if it exceeds reserved capacity. backend: do a sample_budget check at write time and on scheduled jobs.
aj: implementation detail — telemetry sampling config can be modeled as a list of patches on the snapshot (helps with diffs). e.g. `[{"path":"/sampling","op":"replace","value":0.1}]`. keeps the snapshot schema minimal.
chris: one more product concern: metric continuity when forks happen. we should keep lineage so queries can stitch time-series across forks but visually mark breakpoints (dotted line or shaded area). prevents misinterpreting a jump caused by a sampling change.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: snapshots-service v1.3 -> adds parent_id + sampling_rate fields to snapshot schema at 2026-03-21T03:00:00Z (internal note).
mira: next steps: aj to prototype API contract + example payloads, sara to add quota/sampling guard logic, leo to mock the request-edit vs direct-edit UX, ben to draft the one-pager (retention/privacy + cost signals). i'll collect those and circulate an RFC this week. ping me when you post PRs. :thumbsup:
